run_preprocess_ef_cli: run the preprocess_ef script to create LMDB files from extxyz trajectory files for the S2EF task
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run the write_images_to_lmdb function to convert ASE trajectory frames into pickled graph data objects stored in an LMDB database
run_main_preprocess: run the main function to chunk trajectory log files across workers and extract graph features into LMDB databases
run_get_parser: run the get_parser function to create an argparse parser with data-path, out-path, num-workers, ref-energy, and test-data arguments
review_atoms_to_graphs_config: review the AtomsToGraphs initialization with max_neigh=50, radius=6, and configurable energy, forces, and edges options
